content.bridge_context: Building on Grade 4 knowledge of local landmarks, we now explore unique geographical and historical sites across India.

units.title: Natural Wonders
units.explanation: Places created by nature like the Living Root Bridges in Meghalaya or the Valley of Flowers in Uttarakhand.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify natural features. / प्राकृतिक विशेषताओं की पहचान करें।

units.title: Architectural Marvels
units.explanation: Man-made structures with unique designs, like the Sun Temple in Konark or the Jantar Mantar.
units.dual_language_instruction: Describe the design. / डिजाइन का वर्णन करें।
